title: publish-release.mjs must refuse to publish without an opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt for the exact SHA and tarballs
description: Filed on opum-agent dispatch OPAG-379 (2026-09-24T05:34Z), file-only; the orchestrator decides when it is implemented. The ruling is ruling 3 of opum-doc docs/adr/harden-fleet-ci-against-a-single-runner-outage-and-unqualified-publication.md, read here at main 9222079 (committed 2026-09-23T23:57:37-05:00) rather than taken from the relay. The publisher hard-refuses without a qualification receipt from opum-cli-e2e unless an explicit override is written to the record it reads. A warning-only mode was considered and rejected. The ADR names publish-release.sh; this repository equivalent is scripts/publish-release.mjs, which today gates only on the native-execution receipt from this repo own qualification workflow, not on opum-cli-e2e. Motivating incident: lore 0.9.0 shipped while opum-cli-e2e TASK-103 recorded the pair NOT QUALIFIED. Note for whoever implements this: quest 0.10.0 (QCLI-365) was itself published 2026-09-24 at about 05:40Z with no opum-cli-e2e receipt. That was after the ADR, and after the orchestrator said not to interrupt that release for this.

acceptanceCriteria.text: publish-release.mjs refuses a real publish, exiting non-zero before any npm write, when no opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt binds the exact commit SHA and the tarball digests being published
An explicit override is accepted only when written to the record the publisher reads, and the publish output names that override
Proven both ways: a run with no receipt refuses, and a run with a matching receipt proceeds to the dry-run stage
The receipt format and location are agreed with opum-cli-e2e rather than invented here
